verdict: Paid campaigns went dark August 6; leads have stopped since.
narrative: Meta was your only active paid channel this period, delivering 45 leads at $26.04 per lead across $1,171.64 in spend — but all activity stopped on August 6, leaving 12 consecutive days with zero spend and zero leads. With paid traffic gone, organic search clicks have also dropped sharply, as the visibility boost that paid activity normally provides has faded. Separately, 45 leads were received this period but none have moved into your intake pipeline as opportunities, which means follow-up is not connecting. Campaigns are being restarted and the intake pipeline is being reviewed to ensure leads are picked up and progressed from here.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all before August 6
cost per lead while campaigns were active
leads entered into the pipeline as opportunities this period

watch_item.issue: Paid campaigns have been offline since August 6, and organic visibility is declining in parallel.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated and the lead intake pipeline is being reviewed so that incoming leads convert to tracked opportunities.
